kits.title: City street
kits.description: Low-poly street furniture, traffic pieces and road tiles for town and city scenes at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Interior
kits.description: Low-poly furniture and room pieces for homes and offices at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

kits.title: Nature
kits.description: Low-poly trees, rocks, plants and ground pieces at real-world scale, flat-shaded on one palette material.

assets.title: Bike rack
assets.description: Row of inverted-U bicycle stands on two base rails. Knobs: loop count, loop shape, stand and rail colours.

assets.title: Bollard
assets.description: Street bollard post with a reflective band and cap, round-faceted or square. Knobs: height, style, post, band and cap colours.

assets.title: Bus stop shelter
assets.description: Glazed bus stop shelter with a sloped roof, back wall, optional side screens and a bench. Knobs: length, side screens, frame, glass and roof colours.

assets.title: Crosswalk tile
assets.description: 4 m road tile with a zebra crosswalk and edge lines that matches road-tile. Knobs: bar count, asphalt, bar and edge-line colours.

assets.title: Fire hydrant
assets.description: Faceted pillar fire hydrant with flanges, domed bonnet and side outlets. Knobs: outlet count, facets, body and cap colours.

assets.title: Street mailbox
assets.description: Public mail collection box, box style with an arched top on legs or a round pillar box. Knobs: style, body, trim and slot colours.

assets.title: Newspaper box
assets.description: Street newspaper vending box with a window door and coin unit, on a pedestal or legs. Knobs: stand, body, window and stand colours.

assets.title: Park bench
assets.description: Slatted park bench with metal side frames and an optional backrest. Knobs: length, slat count, backrest, slat and frame colours.

assets.title: Parking meter
assets.description: Kerbside parking meter on a post with a single or twin head and display windows. Knobs: heads, post, head and display colours.

assets.title: Picket fence section
assets.description: Tileable picket fence section with pointed pickets, two rails and capped end posts. Knobs: picket count, height, picket and post colours.

assets.title: Planter box
assets.description: Street planter with a rim, soil and a faceted bush, square or round. Knobs: shape, size, planter, rim, foliage and soil colours.

assets.title: Road barrier
assets.description: Striped roadworks barrier board on two A-frame legs. Knobs: length, stripe count, two stripe colours and leg colour.

assets.title: Road sign

assets.title: Road tile

assets.title: Shop front
assets.description: Small one-storey shop with a display window, glazed door, sign band and striped awning. Knobs: width, wall, awning, awning stripe, door/sign and glass colours.

assets.title: Sidewalk tile
assets.description: 4 m raised sidewalk tile with a kerb on the road side and a two-tone paving grid. Knobs: paving grid, kerb, paving and accent colours.

assets.title: Street lamp

assets.title: Street litter bin
assets.description: Faceted public litter bin on a plinth with a rim band and a hooded or flat lid. Knobs: lid style, facets, body, band and lid colours.

assets.title: Armchair

assets.title: Bed

assets.title: Bookshelf

assets.title: Coffee table
assets.description: Low living-room coffee table, rectangular or round, with an optional lower shelf. Knobs: shape, shelf, top and leg colours.

assets.title: Desk

assets.title: Dining chair

assets.title: Dining table

assets.title: Floor lamp

assets.title: Fridge

assets.title: Interior door

assets.title: Kitchen counter

assets.title: Nightstand

assets.title: Office chair

assets.title: Picture frame

assets.title: Sofa

assets.title: Table lamp
assets.description: Bedside or desk table lamp with a faceted jar or column base and a tapered shade. Knobs: base style, base and shade colours.

assets.title: Wardrobe
assets.description: Tall hinged-door wardrobe with two to four doors, plinth and top trim. Knobs: door count, body, door and handle colours.

assets.title: Birch tree

assets.title: Boulder cluster

assets.title: Saguaro cactus

assets.title: Fern
assets.description: Forest-floor fern rosette with arching tapered fronds. Knobs: size, frond count, frond and stalk colours.

assets.title: Palm tree

assets.title: Reeds
